scenarios.title: an image survives a prose rebuild at the remembered caret
an image survives a prose rebuild at the remembered caret in page view

setup: Official portable Node archive checked against official SHA256 sums; official .NET installer; Linux Electron installed from project lockfile.
Missing Debian 13 libraries downloaded as 67 .deb archives and extracted under this directory with dpkg-deb. No global package installation.
Current source copied excluding bin, obj, node_modules, git, output and test-result folders; Linux backend and frontend built successfully.
All test projects, app settings, profiles, caches and dependency installations scoped under this directory; Linux IPC temp files use /tmp. No user project or settings writes.
testBoundary: Production context-menu action, logical bookmark capture, prose rebuild and image insertion execute in the real Linux renderer/backend.

Only native picker is controlled to hold the asynchronous result; both normal/page-view cases deliberately rebuild prose and clear live selection before completion. Tests always close isolated application in finally.

Isolated test harness adds --no-sandbox because the WSL distribution runs as root; test data root remains isolated even though Electron IPC uses native /tmp. The production harness is unchanged for this adaptation.
No claim for physical Linux desktop packaging or platform file-picker behavior; native iOS remains separate device validation.
